platform.limitation.system_proxy_is_advi: The system proxy is a notification, not a security boundary: applications that ignore it are not redirected at all. Use TUN mode for that.
platform.limitation.dns_backend_varies_b: The DNS mechanism differs between distributions: systemd-resolved is not installed by default on Debian and is not enabled by default on Arch, so MyVpn detects the resolver at runtime instead of assuming one.
platform.limitation.process_routing_bloc: On Windows, applications can be blocked from the tunnel but not redirected into it: redirection needs a kernel-mode driver, which MyVpn does not ship.
platform.limitation.pf_not_api: Apple states that the packet filter is not a supported API and recommends Network Extension instead, so the Kill Switch here works today but carries no compatibility guarantee.
platform.limitation.process_routing_uid_: On macOS, per-application tunnelling is not achievable for a self-distributed client. Only blocking by user account is available.
platform.limitation.utun_name_dynamic: macOS assigns tunnel interface numbers dynamically, so the interface is resolved at run time rather than fixed in advance.
